This is an application seeking regular bail filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
2. Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.821/2022 of Koyilandy Police Station, Kozhikode District.

The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 354A(2), 354D, 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Section 4 r/w Section 3 Section 8 r/w Section 7, Section 12, r/w Section 11(iv)
of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012 3.

sentences.text: According to the prosecution, the accused had raped the victim, aged 17 years after kidnapping her from her local guardianship and thereby committed the offences alleged.
4. Smt.Deepa Payyanur, learned Counsel for the petitioner submitted that the prosecution allegations are false and the incident as alleged had not occurred.

It was further submitted that the defacto complainant/victim had not mentioned any instance of sexual assault at the initial stage,
when the FIR was registered.
However, subsequently, she alleged penetrative sexual assault.
According to the learned Counsel, the allegations are raised at the behest of her relatives, and that the allegations are false.
It was further pointed out that petitioner was arrested on 12.12.2022 and has been in custody since then and considering his young age, further detention ought not to be permitted.
BAIL APPL. NO. 10524 OF 2022 5.

Sri .K.A.Noushad, learned Public Prosecutor on the other hand opposed the grant of bail and submitted that the prosecution allegations are serious in nature and also that notice on the victim was served on 19.01.2023.
6. I have considered the rival contentions.
7. Petitioner is only 22 years in age.
He has been in custody since 12.12.2022.
The victim had not at the initial stage, alleged any penetrative sexual assault.
However, subsequently she has made serious allegations against the petitioner.

Having regard to the aforesaid circumstances, and also taking into reckoning the period of detention already undergone, I am of the view that further detention is not essential, especially since she is only 22 years in age.

In the result, this application is allowed on the following conditions:-
(a) Petitioner shall be released on bail on him executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the court having jurisdiction.
(b) Petitioner shall appear before the Investigating Officer as and when required.
(c) Petitioner shall not intimidate or attempt to influence the witnesses; nor shall he tamper with the evidence or contact the victim or her family members.
(d) Petitioner shall not commit any similar offences while he is on bail.

BAIL APPL. NO. 10524 OF 2022

In case of violation of any of the above conditions, the jurisdictional Court shall be empowered to consider the application for cancellation, if any, and pass appropriate orders in accordance with the law, notwithstanding the bail having been granted by this Court.
